🚨 La jaquette complète de GTA 6 vient d'être dévoilée par MediaMarkt !

Elle sera incluse dans la version physique du jeu (code-in-box), sous la forme d'une affiche recto-verso avec l'illustration officielle de la jaquette. 👀

Dommage quand même de choisir d'imprimer ce genre

E11EVEN Miami has dropped new GTA 6-themed merchandise

Limited-edition Vice City hoodies, tees, caps, and bralettes are now available

“GTA 6 is gonna be too exaggerated”

Meanwhile Florida on a random Friday:

Two GTA 6 advertisements have now been vandalized by the same individual.

First, the Jason and Lucia mural in Brooklyn, New York. Now, the Welcome to Vice City billboard outside the Kaseya Center in Miami.

Both were covered with the same graffiti tag.

Hello !

As I said before,  nope no plan to share anything more about GTA

About PS5 Pro, no idea,  hope they release something very soon
GTA 6 trophy details are expected to be revealed soon. 👀
